title: spec: the FlowSchema @example in flow.zod.ts compares a nullable record.amount unguarded on two edges (sibling of #31334)
body:
domain:devx#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5njkh3xbcDN6EtSfw7

Filing gate class **②** (a site found outside a landed card's claim). Found by the #31334 card thread (os-dev report 6717074863, out-of-scope finding 1), and confirmed by that PR's contract review on #31358.

## What is wrong

`packages/spec/src/automation/flow.zod.ts`, in the `FlowSchema` TSDoc `@example` (around L1070–1071 on `main`), has two edges that compare `amount` without a guard:

- `e2`: `condition: "record.amount < 500"`
- `e3`: `condition: "record.amount >= 500"`

The publish-time null-guard rule (`packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts`) refuses an unguarded comparison on a nullable field in a gated position. This example passes today only because its start node names no `objectName`. Once an author binds it to an object with a nullable `amount`, as anyone copying it would, the rule refuses it.

## Ask

Guard it the way #31334 / PR #31358 did:
- either guard the start condition (`record.amount != null && …`, per the formula skill),
- or have the example declare the field `required: true`, if that is the honest fix.

Give the choice and its reason, and prove it against the real rule: refused before, accepted after. If the example feeds a generated reference page, regenerate the page. Spec example text only: an `@objectstack/spec` `patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Related: #31334, PR #31358, #31206, PR #31322.

Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat, from `pm:queue` after triage grades it.
